summary: Matthew Burklow died in an approximately 600-foot fall descending the Ledges on Longs Peak; body recovered by helicopter three days later
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue
notes: Body recovered by helicopter three days later NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry; compendium dates the search to ~2014-06-10, incident date 2014-06-09 per existing source kept.
